programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Burgers. Guy chases down some of the best burgers in America. He tries one made with a quarter pound of cheese and steamed with ice, and then a burger made with peanut butter. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: House Specials. Guy Fieri stops in for some fantastic house specials, like the twenty kinds of pie in a New Hampshire diner, and the signature 'Hobo Scramble' in a Seattle café. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Retro. Guy Fieri rolls out to some legendary joints where time has stayed still, like the Californian '40s take-out burger joint or the Portland café with '50s style red vinyl booths. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Worth The Trip. Guy goes to some places off the beaten track with food worth travelling for, like the chorizo scramble and salmon hash on Bainbridge Island. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Pooch Party. Even man's best friend deserves a treat on his birthday! Ina decides to throw a party for her favourite pooch and his owners on the beach. S7, Ep7

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Tale Of 2 Soups. Ina's recipe testing two of her favourite soups, so she takes them round to a good friend's place for dinner. Will his guests like them as much as Ina does? S7, Ep10

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Cookbook Party. Ina is celebrating finishing her new book with an alfresco party with a Mediterranean theme. She makes some delicious lamb kebabs with a tomato and feta salad. S8, Ep1

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Black And White Party. Ina makes a supper with a Truman Capote theme. On the menu, Capote's favourite chicken hash, pain perdu, and white truffles to finish off the meal. S7, Ep9

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Night Before Dinner. On the menu is a delicious roast loin of pork with fennel stuffing, cauliflower gratin, green vegetables and a pumpkin parfait with ginger biscuits. S8, Ep2

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Going, Going, Gone. For charity Ina auctioned off a special lunch made by her. Using local ingredients, she makes a meal for two of Asian grilled salmon with a crunchy noodle salad. S8, Ep3

programme.title: Jamie's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver shares his secrets for making simple and delicious recipes with just five ingredients, saving time and money but that are big on flavour. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: Michel visits a family-run vineyard to get an important ingredient for his monkfish dish. Plus, he reveals his simple recipe for pate grand-mere. S1, Ep2

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: San Sebastian. James' adventure starts in San Sebastian, a city boasting 16 Michelin stars. After sampling its culinary delights, he cooks Basque stew and pintxos. S1, Ep1

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: La Rioja. James visits Spain's wine region, La Rioja, and a mile long cellar. He eats tapas, enjoys a community garden, and cooks quail, tapas, and leeks. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: Sizzling Steak. Tom Kerridge shows how to use the BBQ for the finest meals. He cooks a Cote de Boeuf cut of beef, and a classic lobster thermidor gets the BBQ treatment. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: Smoking Hot. Tom takes his inspiration from the American BBQ culture for his recipes. He makes sticky baby back ribs, smoked burgers and Caesar salad with a grilled spring cabbage twist. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: The Burger. Tom gets experimental, with a recipe for a chorizo pork burger tower and a seared cucumber salad. Plus, he bakes a cake on his BBQ, full of smoke and honey flavours. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: Ultimate Kebab. Tom fires up his BBQ for a Middle Eastern feast. On the menu are marinated and spiced chicken kebabs, cumin flame grilled flatbread and a creamy aubergine dip. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: Show Off Seafood. Tom brings on beach holiday vibes with a seafood feast. He cooks up a huge seafood platter with razor clams, spice buttered oysters and langoustines. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: Roast Chicken. Tom shares his recipe for jerk spiced chicken that's BBQed sat on top of a beer can, with whole sweetcorn as a side. And, he serves up BBQ chicken wings. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: Stylish Dinner. Tom shows three recipes for an intimate al-fresco dinner for two! Dishes include chicken yakitori skewers with papaya salad, chargrilled seabass and BBQed peaches. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: Slow Cooked Feast. Tom shares his method for slow cooking joints of meat, including spicy slow cooked lamb shoulder, sweet and sticky BBQ short ribs and pulled beef brisket in a bun. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: Superior Sandwich. Tom demonstrates how to make some delectable BBQ sandwiches, including a classic meatball sub roll and fresh tuna steak tacos with zingy salsas. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: Spice Things Up. Tom explores some seriously spicy flavours on his BBQ. He makes fragrant lamb koftas, spicy sweet potato burgers and curried BBQ monkfish. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Jamie's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver shares his secrets for making simple and delicious recipes with just five ingredients, saving time and money but that are big on flavour. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Full Of Surprises. Guy Fieri digs into some surprising ingredients. In Santa Fe, a culinary pub serves lamb neck, and a Kansas City tapas joint dishes out duck tongue tacos! S30, Ep12

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Far-Flung Flavor. Guy Fieri heads out to grab international flavours. Dishes include shawarma and salmon souvlaki in Santa Fe and Scandinavian specialties in Kansas City, Missouri. S30, Ep13

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Classics. Guy Fieri discovers the secret recipe of the cabrito burger at a roadside shack in Texas, before stumbling upon a Mediterranean paradise in the desert. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Italian. Guy finds great Italian food in places people would never expect, like a Tennessee drive-in where they make their own meat sauce and bring the pasta to the customer's car. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Blue Plate Specials. Guy finds incredible specials all over America. He gets the secret to great Italian beef in Chicago, before heading west for the special breakfast, LA-style. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Breakfast. Guy is up early for some of America's best breakfast joints. He tries the famous 'Garbage Plate' in Kenosha, before checking out the Chili Verde omelette in Boulder City. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: BBQ. Guy is on the hunt for the best barbecue in America. He tries some world famous brisket, and goes to a place where carhops bring pulled pork and fried chicken to the car. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Local Legends. Guy finds some places that have been drawing the crowds for years. He tries gourmet specials in Maine, amazing ribs in Oklahoma and home-made bread in New York. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Sausage, Shawarma And Scaloppini. Guy Fieri is on the road to sample all kinds of food. In Delaware, he digs into arancini and veal scaloppini, and samples falafel in San Diego. S30, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: British, Hawaiian And Mexican. Guy Fieri gets a taste of international flavours. A true British pub serves authentic English staples, while a Mexican spot is spicing up shrimps. S30, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Standout Seafood. Guy Fieri is on the road to sample first-class seafood. At a restaurant-market in Vancouver, he digs into bouillabaisse and salmon fish and chips. S30, Ep5

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Crazy Chicken, Twisted Burgers. Guy Fieri is digging into chicken and burgers. An eatery in San Diego is spicing up a mushroom sandwich and stuffing shawarma into sausage. S30, Ep6

programme.title: Man V. Food

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Knoxville. Adam Richman is in Knoxville, Tennessee, trying out some monumental hand-cut steaks, unique burgers and a five-pound barbecue burrito challenge. S2, Ep39

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Miami. Adam Richman is in Miami for the grandfather of all food challenges: legendary football coach Don Shula's massive 48-ounce steak. S2, Ep41

programme.title: Man vs Food Nation
programme.desc: Albuquerque. Adam hunts for delicious and indulgent food in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Later, he recruits locals to take down a monstrous beef and bean burrito challenge. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Man vs Food Nation
programme.desc: Harlem. Adam visits one of Harlem's most historic soul food joints to try what locals say is the best chicken and waffles in town. And, he helps locals defeat the Squealer Challenge. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Man vs Food Nation
programme.desc: Tampa Bay. Adam is on the hunt for authentic flavours and delicious dishes in Tampa, Florida. Later, he recruits a pro-wrestler to take down a scorching hot platter of wings. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Man vs Food Nation
programme.desc: Nashville. Adam's culinary crusade brings him to Nashville, Tennessee. He tries to guide two of the city's newest stars, the LoCash Cowboys, through the Rooster Challenge. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Man vs Food Nation
programme.desc: New Haven. Adam chows down on mouth-watering meals in New Haven, Connecticut. Later, he aims to help a college freshman defeat the Caseus Cheese Truck Challenge. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Man vs Food Nation
programme.desc: Tulsa. In Tulsa, Adam tries the monstrous Double Okie Burger and one of the city's most legendary steaks. Later, he guides Tulsa's firefighters through a fiery pizza challenge. S1, Ep6

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: Bilbao. In Bilbao James visits a huge indoor food market. He takes a funicular to a steak restaurant, sees a winery on a seabed, and cooks Basque cheesecake. S1, Ep3

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: Asturias. In Asturias James meets a family who live off grid. He samples fabada stew, visits a restaurant famous for its sardines, and makes pancetta and clams. S1, Ep4

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Ramen Japan
programme.desc: A unique ramen loaded with fresh local vegetables! Savor a premium bowl packed with rich chicken flavour.

programme.title: Core Kyoto Mini
programme.desc: Gifts are exchanged in the traditional betrothal rite - paper cords are twisted into intricate shapes and decorate gifts.

programme.title: Easy Japanese for Work
programme.desc: Today: cheering up a junior employee who is feeling down. Nyamjav Baljinnyam from Mongolia works at a car maintenance company - he takes on a role play challenge to help improve his Japanese skills.

programme.title: Zero Waste Life
programme.desc: Taoda Ayane does amazing things with milk cartons by transforming them into accessories, bags, and even clothing - the cartons are strong and water-resistant and so her creations are practical too.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Somewhere Street
programme.desc: Once a bustling garment district, Sentier is now home to many Internet start-ups and hosts new restaurants, galleries and boutiques that make it a dynamic hub for trendsetting businesses in Paris.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Chatroom Japan
programme.desc: A spotlight on our diverse international community as we report on issues, speak to those involved, and get a fresh look at what it's like to live in Japan.

programme.title: Impacts: Climates Change the World
programme.desc: Reductions in Arctic sea ice caused by global warming have ironically led to record-breaking Northern Hemisphere snowfalls and frequent winter storms - what mechanism is at work?

programme.desc: Hokkaido / Takeya Takayuki (model maker) Fishing boats in the herring industry-which thrived here until the 1950s-featured swirling decorations that made a big impression on Takeya, a Hokkaido native.

programme.title: The Factory Wonders
programme.desc: We visit a factory making straw hats. Find out how new ideas about design and quality transformed a producer of cheap farmers' hats into an international-award-winning brand of fashionable headwear.

programme.title: Time-Lapse Japan
programme.desc: Hagi, a World Heritage site of ten described as an 'open-air museum,' is lined with merchant and samurai houses and retains much of its 17th-century townscape. Soak in the atmosphere, in time-lapse.

programme.title: NHK Newsline

programme.title: The Seasons of Yamato

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Be earthquake-ready and learn survival tips for quakes and when you're trapped under rubble - you'll want to watch this before your next trip to Japan!

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history, and culture - this episode looks at words related to kaku ('to write'). Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.title: Easy Japanese
programme.desc: #28 May I take photos here? / When seeking permission to do something, change the end of a verb to 'te' (for example, 'toru' [take] becomes 'totte'), then add 'mo ii desu ka'.

programme.title: Culture Crossroads
programme.desc: Efforts to save children have evolved in a unique way that energises people who provide services - we introduce a splendid international example of such an initiative in Matsuyama in Ehime Prefecture.

programme.desc: In March, NHK World-Japan launched a new online hub for Bosai-preparing for disaster. It has pages, apps and guides, in multiple languages. We also see programmes about June's theme: Mount Fuji.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Coverage of the second quarter-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. At this stage of the tournament in Qatar, the Netherlands and Argentina faced each other for the 10th time overall and the third time of a World Cup knockout stage, with previous meetings being a memorable 3-1 win for Argentina on home soil in the 1978 final, while the Dutch triumphed 2-1 in a 1998 quarter-final in France. On this occasion in Lusail a record number of cautions were given by the referee as he brandished 18 yellow cards in a highly charged affair. Lionel Messi engaged in a touchline confrontation with opposing manager Louis van Gaal, and even in a post-match incident with Wout Weghorst, who scored both goals for the Netherlands as the match ended 2-2 after extra-time, cancelling out the earlier goals of Nahuel Molina and Messi, the latter of whom scored from the penalty spot. In the subsequent shootout, Argentine goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez saved the first two efforts of Virgil van Dijk and from Steven Berghuis, and while Enzo Fernández missed one for his side, Argentina prevailed 4-3 and advanced to the last four

programme.desc: Coverage of the fourth quarter-final (Kick-off 2.00am), which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Familiar foes England and France faced each other for the 32nd time in the corresponding match in Qatar, and it was France who came out on top in a see-saw encounter. Aurélien Tchouaméni was first on the scoresheet for France in the 17th minute, and it took until the 54th minute for England to draw level through a Harry Kane penalty, as he scored a record-equalling 53rd goal for his country. Olivier Giroud, who entered the contest as the top scorer for his own country, put Les Bleus back in the driving seat as he somewhat remarkably also netted a 53rd international goal. The Three Lions had the opportunity to level the score once again when they were awarded a VAR penalty four minutes from full time, but this time Kane saw his effort blaze over the bar and England were eliminated in the quarter-finals for a record seventh time, while Didier Deschamps' men became the first reigning champions to reach the last four since Brazil in 1998

programme.desc: Coverage of the fourth quarter-final (Kick-off 2.00am), which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Familiar foes England and France faced each other for the 32nd time in the corresponding match in Qatar, and it was France who came out on top in a see-saw encounter. Aurélien Tchouaméni was first on the scoresheet for France in the 17th minute, and it took until the 54th minute for England to draw level through a Harry Kane penalty, as he scored a record-equalling 53rd goal for his country. Olivier Giroud, who entered the contest as the top scorer for his own country, put Les Bleus back in the driving seat as he somewhat remarkably also netted a 53rd international goal. The Three Lions had the opportunity to level the score once again when they were awarded a VAR penalty four minutes from full time, but this time Kane saw his effort blaze over the bar and England were eliminated in the quarter-finals for a record seventh time, while Didier Deschamps' men became the first reigning champions to reach the last four since Brazil in 1998

programme.desc: Coverage of the second quarter-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. On this occasion in Lusail a record number of cautions were given by the referee as he brandished 18 yellow cards in a highly charged affair. Lionel Messi engaged in a touchline confrontation with opposing manager Louis van Gaal, and even in a post-match incident with Wout Weghorst, who scored both goals for the Netherlands as the match ended 2-2 after extra-time, cancelling out the earlier goals of Nahuel Molina and Messi, the latter of whom scored from the penalty spot. programme.desc: Coverage of the fourth quarter-final (Kick-off 2.00am), which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Familiar foes England and France faced each other for the 32nd time in the corresponding match in Qatar, and it was France who came out on top in a see-saw encounter. Aurélien Tchouaméni was first on the scoresheet for France in the 17th minute, and it took until the 54th minute for England to draw level through a Harry Kane penalty, as he scored a record-equalling 53rd goal for his country. Olivier Giroud, who entered the contest as the top scorer for his own country, put Les Bleus back in the driving seat as he somewhat remarkably also netted a 53rd international goal. The Three Lions had the opportunity to level the score once again when they were awarded a VAR penalty four minutes from full time, but this time Kane saw his effort blaze over the bar and England were eliminated in the quarter-finals for a record seventh time, while Didier Deschamps' men became the first reigning champions to reach the last four since Brazil in 1998

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Coverage of the second quarter-final (Kick-off 8.00pm), which takes place at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. At this stage of the tournament in Qatar, the Netherlands and Argentina faced each other for the 10th time overall and the third time of a World Cup knockout stage, with previous meetings being a memorable 3-1 win for Argentina on home soil in the 1978 final, while the Dutch triumphed 2-1 in a 1998 quarter-final in France. On this occasion in Lusail a record number of cautions were given by the referee as he brandished 18 yellow cards in a highly charged affair. Lionel Messi engaged in a touchline confrontation with opposing manager Louis van Gaal, and even in a post-match incident with Wout Weghorst, who scored both goals for the Netherlands as the match ended 2-2 after extra-time, cancelling out the earlier goals of Nahuel Molina and Messi, the latter of whom scored from the penalty spot. In the subsequent shootout, Argentine goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez saved the first two efforts of Virgil van Dijk and from Steven Berghuis, and while Enzo Fernández missed one for his side, Argentina prevailed 4-3 and advanced to the last four

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v England (Kick-off 2.10pm). Jill Douglas presents all the action from the round-robin match at Hill Dickinson Stadium in Liverpool. While Fiji are the designated hosts, the match is being played here because their main stadium does not meet the competition requirements. England prevailed 38-18 when the teams last met at Allianz Stadium Twickenham last November and will expect another victory this afternoon. With analysis from Danny Care and Maggie Alphonsi, commentary by Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay, and pitchside inserts from Topsy Ojo

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: South Africa v Scotland (Kick-off 4.40pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the round-robin match at Loftus Versfeld Stadium in Pretoria. Scotland face a daunting task away to the world champions, who have won the last nine meetings between the sides. The most recent of those contests was a 32-15 victory for the Springboks in a 2024 autumn international at Murrayfield. With analysis from Grieg Laidlaw, Bryan Habana and John Barclay, and commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? Christmas Special
programme.desc: Celebrity Traitors veteran Joe Marler and comedian Katherine Ryan each hope to climb the money ladder and raise funds for their chosen charities. As usual there will be lifelines, including 50:50, Ask the Audience, Phone a Friend, and Ask the Host. With up to £1 million on the table, who will hold their nerve under Jeremy Clarkson's gaze and can anyone beat Stephen Fry's impressive £250,000 win?

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: Bradley and Barney arrive in Brisbane, where they swap the RV for electric scooters to explore the city. The pair head to the local racetrack, where they go head to head in a sport known to the locals as 'the trots', and end the day with a group who gather every week to immerse themselves in medieval fantasy role-play. They also meet a man who went viral thanks to a very unexpected talent, before Barney plans another adrenaline-fuelled treat for his dad

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Norway v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the third quarter-final, which takes place at Miami Stadium in the USA. This is a step into the unknown for the Norwegians, who have never made it to a World Cup quarter-final, and did so in style, beating Brazil 2-0 in the last round, courtesy of two more goal from Erling Haaland. England overcame several obstacles to win 3-2 against Mexico in the last 16, producing one of their finest performances to hold on and book a quarter-final place, with Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham once again among the goals

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Stephen Mangan hosts the game show, with Emerson and Becky joining captains Daisy May Cooper and Alan Carr to guess mystery words across multiple rounds as they try to win £10,000

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Coverage of the fourth quarter-final (Kick-off 2.00am), which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Familiar foes England and France faced each other for the 32nd time in the corresponding match in Qatar, and it was France who came out on top in a see-saw encounter. Aurélien Tchouaméni was first on the scoresheet for France in the 17th minute, and it took until the 54th minute for England to draw level through a Harry Kane penalty, as he scored a record-equalling 53rd goal for his country. Olivier Giroud, who entered the contest as the top scorer for his own country, put Les Bleus back in the driving seat as he somewhat remarkably also netted a 53rd international goal. The Three Lions had the opportunity to level the score once again when they were awarded a VAR penalty four minutes from full time, but this time Kane saw his effort blaze over the bar and England were eliminated in the quarter-finals for a record seventh time, while Didier Deschamps' men became the first reigning champions to reach the last four since Brazil in 1998

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: Adil Ray hosts as RuPaul's Drag Race UK stars Tia Kofi and Danny Beard take on former England goalkeeper David Seaman and his wife, Dancing on Ice professional Frankie Seaman, in the game of words. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords

programme.desc: Daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection

programme.title: Deal or No Deal: Banker's Best Battles
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts a look back at some of the most iconic Deal or No Deal episodes. Matthew and Alex are given their opportunity to open the iconic red boxes this time, but do they stay strong and resist the Banker's tempting offers in the hope of being rewarded with the 100,000-pound jackpot?

programme.title: In for a Penny
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern takes the show across the pond for a special long episode from Walt Disney World Resort in Florida with classic games and brand-new ones too.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: The chef heads to Saint-Tropez, where a local tour guide explains how Brigitte Bardot transformed the town from a quiet fishing village to an international hotspot. After exploring the area, James drops in on old friend Michel Roux and they prepare a rather special barbecue

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Actress Joanna David chats to Alan at Manor Farm about her time on Celebrity Gogglebox, while floral designer Simon Lycett shows off an autumn bouquet. Plus, the rare-breed sheep leading the way in British fine wool, and a look at the best in British craft beer

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: Fern Britton returns to the Grove Vets in Bristol for an insight into the running of a busy practice at the heart of the local community. Pets brought in include a Romanian rescue dog with a lump in his mouth, a floppy-eared Doberman with a sore paw, and a pair of lively cavalier King Charles spaniel sisters who are due to be spayed. Fern lends a hand in the much-needed grooming of a long-haired cat

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team are on the Wirral to create a jungle-inspired outdoor space for Conrad and Pauline Toohey, who have dedicated their lives to helping others, including severely disabled son Keiron. Their garden is so overgrown some of the family have not used it for decades, so Alan and the team transform the garden into a tranquil retreat with a pond to attract wildlife, and covered pergola surrounded by tropical planting. Meanwhile, Frances Tophill is in Cornwall to visit the UK's only outdoor jungle at the Lost Gardens of Heligan, where she helps head gardener Cindy plant some pond lilies
